# AteneiOnline

> > AteneiOnline is a comprehensive guide to online degree programs and master's courses from Italian telematic universities including eCampus, Pegaso, Unimarconi, San Raffaele, Unicusano, and UniFortunato.

The platform provides detailed information about bachelor's degrees (laurea triennale), master's degrees (laurea magistrale), and specialized master's programs across disciplines including law, psychology, healthcare, engineering, sports sciences, and humanities. Each program listing includes study plans, career prospects (sbocchi lavorativi), costs, and institutional details.

## Key Topics

- eCampus
- Pegaso
- Unimarconi
- San Raffaele
- Unicusano
- UniFortunato
- Laurea Magistrale (Master's Degrees)
- Laurea Triennale (Bachelor's Degrees)
- Master di II Livello (Level II Master's)
- Formazione Online (Online Education)
- Professioni Sanitarie (Healthcare Professions)
- Telematica (Distance Learning)
- Piano Studi (Study Plans)
- Sbocchi Lavorativi (Career Prospects)
- ECM Credits for Healthcare

## Bachelor's Degrees (Laurea Triennale)

- [Laurea Triennale Online in Servizi Giuridici L-14 eCampus](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-triennale-l-14-servizi-giuridici-ecampus): eCampus L-14 Bachelor's in Legal Services with costs & study plan
- [Lingue e Culture Europee e del Resto del Mondo L-11 eCampus](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-triennale-l-11-lingue-e-culture-europee-e-del-resto-del-mondo-ecampus): eCampus L-11 European Languages & Cultures with Erasmus+ opportunities
- [Ingegneria Informatica e Intelligenza Artificiale San Raffaele](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-online-l-08-ingegneria-informatica-intelligenza-artificiale-san-raffaele): San Raffaele L-08 Computer Engineering & AI with Machine Learning focus
- [Laurea in Scienze e Tecniche Psicologiche (Psicologia dei Processi di Base) L-24 Unimarconi](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-triennale-l-24-scienze-e-tecniche-psicologiche-unimarconi): Unimarconi L-24 Psychological Sciences (Basic Processes) online degree

## Master's Degrees (Laurea Magistrale)

- [Laurea in Sviluppo Economico-Sociale dell'Ambiente LM-88 Unicusano](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-magistrale-lm-88-sociologia-e-ricerca-sociale-unicusano): Unicusano LM-88 Master's in Socio-Economic Development & Criminology
- [Scienze e Tecniche per l'Attività Motoria LM-67 San Raffaele](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-magistrale-lm-67-scienze-e-tecniche-per-l-attivita-motoria-preventiva-e-adattata-san-raffaele): San Raffaele LM-67 Preventive & Adapted Physical Activity Sciences
- [Laurea in Filologia e Letterature Moderne (Italianistica) LM-14 Unimarconi](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-magistrale-lm-14-filologia-e-letterature-moderne-unimarconi): Unimarconi LM-14 Modern Philology & Italian Literature Master's degree
- [Laurea in Scienze della Nutrizione Umana LM-61 San Raffaele](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-magistrale-lm-61-scienze-della-nutrizione-umana-san-raffaele): San Raffaele LM-61 Human Nutrition Sciences with nutraceutical focus
- [Organizzazione e Gestione dei Servizi per lo Sport e le Attività Motorie LM-47 UniFortunato](https://www.ateneionline.it/corsi-di-laurea-online/laurea-magistrale-lm-47-organizzazione-e-gestione-dei-servizi-per-lo-sport-e-le-attivita-motorie-unifortunato): UniFortunato LM-47 Sports & Physical Activity Services Management degree

## Healthcare & Medical Master's Programs

- [Master II livello in Gestione della violenza in ambito sociale, sanitario ed educativo eCampus](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/gestione-violenza-ambito-sociale-sanitario-educativo-2-livello-ecampus): eCampus Master II in violence management for social, health & education
- [Master Online in Case manager eCampus](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/case-manager-ecampus): eCampus Case Manager Master with ECM credits for healthcare professionals
- [Master Online in Aspetti legali e forensi nelle professioni sanitarie Pegaso](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/aspetti-legali-forensi-professioni-sanitarie-pegaso): Pegaso Master in Legal & Forensic Aspects for Healthcare Professionals
- [Master Online in Ostetricia di comunità Pegaso](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/ostetricia-comunita-pegaso): Pegaso online Master in Community Midwifery with costs & study plan
- [Master Online in Medicina integrata Unimarconi](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/medicina-integrata-unimarconi): Unimarconi Level II Master in Integrative Medicine & complementary therapies

## Specialized Master's Programs

- [Master Online in Pedagogista giuridico Pegaso](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/pedagogista-giuridico-pegaso): Pegaso Master in Legal Pedagogy for socio-educational reintegration
- [Master Online in Scienze dell'economia Unidav](https://www.ateneionline.it/master-online/scienze-economia-unidav): Unidav LM-56 Master's in Economic Sciences with integrative credits
